patch: You get what I'm saying, right Dannie? After all, the Titan that imprisoned you and Gray here in Amphoreus is none other than Aquila themself...
After all, it was you and her who lit the first spark of this journey, wasn't it?
The last baton... I wonder how long you'll have to wait before passing it on to her?
Miss Clementine, Mr. Krateros, and countless others who have heeded Gray's call... guided by the rainbow. They're sending back good news, all to the same tune...
Just like how we are in the Flame-Chasing team, Sevie must be the person who cheers everyone up in the Trailblazing group. Look, Gray is now a lot more relaxed with Miss March here!
